resolved_conflicts.explanation: Firelookout.com says a cupola cabin in 1928; the Forest Lookouts page says a lookout house constructed c. 1935. Both are kept as events, and the story says the sources disagree.
Forest Lookouts says removed; the FFLA list says Ground Gone; firelookout.com says Abandoned with no date. Gone is kept as the status because two sources support it.

A separate Sugar Loaf lookout at the head of the Sixes River (Curry County) is listed on the Forest Lookouts site under the same Coos County patrol association. It is not this site and is mentioned only to prevent confusion.

notes_for_editor: Thin record: two short entries on the Forest Lookouts and firelookout.com pages, one FFLA list line, and no source describing the site today. Build date disagrees (1928 cupola cabin vs c. 1935 lookout house); both are kept. The 1923 entry on the Forest Lookouts Coos page is cut off in the cached text after the opening quote mark, so it is not used. The Curry County Sugar Loaf (Sixes River) is a different site. The FFLA list ties the register number US 1768 to it, and the existing Clatsop-county record carries its coordinates (42.83802, -124.23487), which is worth a separate look. Agency: the Coos page says Coos County FPA; the full name Coos County Fire Patrol Association comes from the Curry page, so it is not used for this site. Access: no source found, so the access key is omitted. Untried: the Coquille Valley Sentinel and Coos Bay Times items cited on the Forest Lookouts pages (not in the cache), and any Coos County or Coquille newspaper coverage of a 1958 or later removal. Kind ground-level is in the record and is not changed here.
